description: List attachment metadata for a specific Zendesk macro, including filenames, content types, sizes, and download URLs. The response may include a next-page URL.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing attachments of a macro.

macro_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the macro whose attachments you want to retrieve. You can find this ID from the macros list endpoint or from the macro URL in Zendesk.
